notes.title: Blast the Past "BIG NOW" update additions
notes.content: Hey guys we have added a number of additional secrets for you to find.

notes.title: Performance Hotfix
notes.content: A number of players have experienced some performance issues. These problems are now gone.

notes.title: Blast the Past "BIG NOW" update
notes.content:
Hey everybody, we are happy to announce that there is a BIG content update available NOW for Blast the Past!
This update does not only introduce two new houses for you to destroy but also many new items to discover.
We have also added Steam achievements for you to earn as well as Steam leaderboards for ESPORTS. :D

The update is available now and we hope that you are as excited as we are!

PS.: We also fixed some minor bugs and added some quality of life features such as a camera recenter button.

ːsteamhappyː
